The Orvik Commercial Dairy Framework

Three Pillars of Profitable Dairy Farming

Sustainable dairy profitability is engineered around three biological cornerstones. Every Orvik product is formulated to serve one or more of these pillars.

01

Calf a Year

Timely Heat, Timely Conception & Clean Uterus

Every extra open day beyond 90 days post-calving costs dairy farmers ₹250-₹350/day. Orvik's fertility & uterine protocol ensures rapid uterine involution, expulsion of lochia, and prompt follicular development for guaranteed 12-month calving interval.

Prescribed Formulations:
TFS PowderMetho-chelated minerals for anestrus & repeat breeding
UTRO-HEAL Liquid24-herb ecbolic for placenta release & clean uterus
  • Eliminates silent heat & delayed puberty in heifers
  • Prevents metritis, pyometra & retained fetal membranes
  • Maximizes lifetime milk cycles per cow
Explore Calf a Year Protocol
02

Peak Milk Production

High Lactation Persistence, High SNF & Mastitis Defense

Reaching peak yield by 45-60 days in lactation and sustaining the yield curve is essential for farm profitability. Orvik provides double-strength chelated calcium, bio-available phosphorus, and therapeutic Vitamin-H for udder cistern development.

Prescribed Formulations:
Chelated ORVICAL GOLDDouble strength liquid calcium in mango flavor
ORVICAL-P GranulesMCHC bio-calcium & phosphorus feed supplement
UDDER-AYU2000 mcg Vitamin-H for udder size & mastitis prevention
  • Enhances daily milk yield by 1.5L to 3.0L per cow
  • Significantly boosts fat and SNF percentages
  • Builds strong teat barrier to stop mastitis pathogens
Explore Peak Milk Production Protocol
03

Smooth Transition

Hypocalcemia Prevention, Liver Protection & Rumen Care

The critical transition period (-21 to +21 days of calving) triggers 80% of veterinary emergencies. Orvik shields transition cows from acute milk fever downer syndrome, ketosis, and liver breakdown with high-dose ionic calcium gels and lipotropic tonics.

Prescribed Formulations:
Advance ORVICAL Gel10,000mg elemental calcium drench for acute calving
ORVI GUARDTricholine citrate & herbal liver restorative tonic
D-Yeast Powder40 Billion CFU live yeast for rumen microflora
  • Zero downer cow syndrome & zero acute milk fever
  • Eliminates ketosis, displaced abomasum & fatty liver
  • Ensures immediate post-calving rumination and appetite
Explore Smooth Transition Protocol

Integrated Commercial Herd Management Protocol

Combining all three pillars reduces veterinary costs by up to 45% and improves lifetime lactation volume per cow.

Pharmaceutical Integrity

Why Dairy Farmers & Veterinarians Choose Orvik

Every formulation undergoes rigorous analytical testing for stability, active potency, and targeted bioavailability in ruminants and livestock.

Metho-Chelated Mineral Technology

Conventional inorganic mineral salts react with rumen antinutrients and pass unabsorbed. Our Methionine Hydroxy Analogue (MHA) chelated minerals resist rumen degradation for complete intestinal absorption.

Rumen-Protected Bio-Actives

Formulations like Orvikind-Plus B1 incorporate Rumen-Protected Choline to bypass microbial breakdown and deliver direct hepatic lipotropic action to reverse fatty liver and negative energy balance.

Standardized Ayurvedic Galactagogues

Products such as Utro-Heal Liquid and Chelated Orvical Gold feature standardized galactagogues (Shatavari, Jivanti, Ashwagandha) providing natural let-down hormones without side-effects.
